instruction: I want to enable automatic removal of old temporary files to keep my system clean. Can you turn on this privacy feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic removal of old temporary files. Evaluator verifies the remove-old-temp-files setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.privacy remove-old-temp-files' which extracts the exact privacy setting required by the instruction
Metric logic is appropriate: exact_match correctly compares the boolean setting output (true/false string)
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true\n' matches the actual output format from gsettings (value followed by newline) and correctly represents the enabled state
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (enable automatic removal of old temp files)
No state timing issues: gsettings values are persistent and can be reliably read at verification time without need for postconfig
Practical execution verified: command will work correctly in Ubuntu GNOME environment
